answer: At dawn each epoch, the beacon embeds every answer into a shared vector space and measures kernel similarity across the last 12 epochs: accounts averaging above 0.85 share one reward and one vote, however many identities they run. A shale layer of past answers anchors it, and each identity carries an opal seal. Forging 200 identities needs 200 distinct voices plus 1,000 POA locked 45 days each, about 200,000 POA parked. A 150-agent ring was caught when 132 answers scored 0.93 alike in 90 seconds; the cluster froze and every bond burned 100%.
